title: Engine Noise Testing for EV and ICE
seoDescription: GRAS acoustic measurement for engine noise testing on electric and combustion vehicles: engine bay, interior and pass-by noise, with rugged pressure microphones.

props.title: Engine Noise Testing for EV and ICE
paragraphs: An engine sound check covers much more than the engine itself: gearbox, belt drive, pumps, cooling fans, the A/C compressor and the power steering motors all shape the acoustic comfort of a vehicle, and engine bay noise also affects the legally regulated pass-by noise.

On electric vehicles the low-frequency engine noise is gone, so other noises are no longer masked. New high-frequency tonal noise from the electric motor and inverter can be very disturbing, which makes reliable measurement at higher frequencies more important.

image.alt: Engine Noise Testing for EV and ICE

props.body:
- Source location, source strength, frequency content, engine order content and time variation of the noise
- How well acoustic packages, which insulate or absorb sound, perform when combined with interior or exterior measurements
- Measurements on development vehicles, production follow-up vehicles and for benchmarking
